Name: Persistent Mines
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Persistent Mines[/b] makes items you place in the mines (but not the skull caverns) persist after leaving the mines.

Note that time will not pass for these things if you aren't there, and things like "overnight updates" won't happen for the items there either.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and (probably) multiplayer.

Might not be compatible with PyTK.
